data.name: LaBlue Horror
data.detailed_description:
DON'T LOSE YOUR MIND

LaBlue Horror is a psychological first-person horror game that throws you into a world where familiar places slowly stop making sense.

Endless yellow hallways are only the beginning. Around every corner, an entirely different environment may be waiting for you — abandoned buildings, strange facilities, dark sectors and places that should never exist.

Your goal is simple: Find a way out.

But the deeper you go, the less you can trust your own senses. Sounds follow you through empty rooms. Lights flicker without explanation. Something seems to be watching you — even when there is nothing there.

PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR

LaBlue Horror does not rely solely on monsters or constant chase sequences. The greatest threat is uncertainty.

You never know whether the sound behind you actually means something — or whether the game simply wants you to turn around.

EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN

Discover different surreal environments connected through a world that constantly changes its atmosphere, lighting and identity.

From familiar abandoned Backrooms to strange and unexpected locations, you never truly know what awaits you next.

FEATURES

• Psychological first-person horror
• Backrooms-inspired surreal environments
• Atmospheric lighting and sound design
• Unpredictable horror events and disturbing encounters
• Multiple unique areas to explore
• Focus on tension, uncertainty and atmosphere instead of constant combat
• Continued development with new areas, events and gameplay systems

You are not here to fight.
You are here to find a way out.

data.short_description: LaBlue Horror is a first-person psychological horror game set in a dark Backrooms-inspired maze. Explore, hide, survive and find the exit before the creature finds you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
  • VR Support:
  • Additional Notes: M.2 SSD recommended for smoother loading.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows compatible audio device
  • VR Support:
  • Additional Notes: M.2 SSD recommended for smoother loading.

content_descriptors.notes: LaBlue Horror contains dark and oppressive horror environments, frightening sounds, jump scares, psychological tension, hostile creatures, chase sequences and non-graphic player death. Players may be pursued and caught by a dangerous creature. The game contains no nudity, sexual content, drug use or self-harm.
